notes.title: Follow our Steam Developer Page now (:
notes.notes:
Hey y'all!

We are about to announce some exciting news about our upcoming puzzle-adventure indie game "[b]Professor Lupo and his Horrible Pets[/b]", the game in which you will have to save the skin of an intern that refuses to become the food of some cute-but-lethal aliens.

If you don't want to miss any news about this game or any of our other future upcoming projects, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/33018510]follow our Steam Developer Page now![/url] Just click on the "[b]Follow[/b]" button and, if you are interested in learning how to cook delicious interns for aliens, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/741520/Professor_Lupo_and_his_Horrible_Pets/]wishlist our game![/url]

Also, remember [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/252670/Nihilumbra/]Nihilumbra is 70% OFF[/url][/b] this week for Steam's summer sale. Welcome summer!!

Stay tuned friends <3
[b]BeautiFun Games.[/b]

Our second announcement has relation with "[b][url=store.steampowered.com/app/422650]Megamagic: Wizards of the Neon Age[/url][/b]", our retro-eighties synthwave brain-shaker... which is 50% OFF! Grab your neon wand, make Phoban grow a Santa's beard and save some money before 2017 arrives.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5177596/2b13ead9753ba3c05620ecaecc4930557d7a21c3.jpg[/img]

Enjoy the holidays and happy new year folks 🎉🎈
[b]- BeautiFun Games Team.[/b]

notes.title: BeautiFun Games at IndieCade16!
notes.notes:
We have been a bit quiet these last five days… the reason? We were still suffering the jet-lag of our 15 hour flight to [b]Los Angeles[/b]! But, for those who have been checking out our social networks, you know we’ve been busy as hell :D

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/19043373/dc48acd3b6c8d9f35efb876090b908022426f421.jpg[/img]

As we told you on our previous post, we were attending for four days IndieCade Festival at the University of Southern California, presenting our latest title [b]“Megamagic: Wizards of the Neon Age“[/b], and also meeting all the game developers, publishers and fans who where there too.

We had the chance to show our game to [b]Sony[/b] and Abigail Tyson from [b]Adult Swim[/b] (we absolutely love EVERYTHING from Adult Swim – from the videogames they publish to Rick and Morty and UMO’s videoclip!). Hopefully, we will tell you some news very soon in relation to this… but let’s don’t anticipate anything!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/19043373/071224129969512dcbd039d8cdabbbd57731722d.jpg[/img]

Also, we met the people from [b]Polyraptor Games[/b] (Uruguay) and [b]The Stonebot Studio[/b] (El Salvador). It was such an honour to get to know each other and play your games Rumpus and Stereo Aereo. They look incredible (handsome) and we are looking forward to play them on our consoles, computers or mobile devices :) 

In November we have another festival coming, and this time on Bilbao (Spain). BeautiFun Games will be at [b]Fun & Serious Festival, and also Megamagic[/b], so see you there! For now, we will share with all of you some photos from our trip to LA: http://beautifungames.com/?p=2306

notes.title: BeautiFun Games will be at IndieCade 2016
notes.notes:
We’ll be attending the Californian festival from [b] Oct 13th to 16th! [/b]

It’s been a year or so since our last videogame festival abroad, but Festival Season has arrived again for BeautiFun Games. This time, our studio has its next stop in [b] Los Angeles, California [/b]. We are already preparing our long journey to Orange County from the distance (Barcelona!), as you can see:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5177596/73205af2160805afe3bdfc810b74842b9efc58ef.jpg[/img]

September has been a busy month for us: we have been preparing our trip and also giving the final touches to [b] new projects [/b] we are currently working on… and we will be unveil some details sooner than later.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5177596/0cee7f65c8f2966a3b4e28e05a535bd5dfb7960c.jpg[/img]

Even though our game “Megamagic: Wizards of the Neon Age” was not selected in IndieCade 2016’s official selection, we will be attending the whole festival, including the IndieXchange and the GameTasting events. In case you are interested in getting in touch with us or to become acquainted of our games, just send us an email here [b]info@beautifungames.com[/b] and let’s meet at IndieCade 2016… or at Hollywood Boulevard!

Have an incredible day,

- [b]BeautiFun Games Team.[/b]

notes.title: OFFICIAL ANNOUNCEMENT: Megamagic available on April 20th!
notes.notes:
Nihilumbra’s birthplace BeautiFun Games have great news: Megamagic is almost here! We’ve been busy these months working on our new release, an action RPG full of 80’s vibes. It’s quite different from Nihilumbra but we think you will enjoy it.

The official release date is scheduled for 20th April 2016 via Steam. You can check out Megamagic's Steam page here: http://store.steampowered.com/app/422650/ 

Also, we have a new trailer, featuring new scenarios, characters, spells and grims: https://youtu.be/88umKql_tJk 

Get ready to immerse yourself into the Neon Age!
BeautiFun Games Team.

notes.title: Nihilumbra 1.3 update is up and running!
notes.notes:
Our beloved coders have been working hard to get rid of as many of the bugs you reported as possible.

After fixing and testing, here is Nihilumbra 1.3 changelist:

- Fixed a common default screen resolution problem.

- Fixed a strange bug with the default application language.

- Fixed a deadlock at the Ash Desert Void level, caused by application running at low FPS. 

- Various fixes with Chinese and Spanish languages.

Thank you all of you who reported your issues with the game.

We wish you have a great and much less buggy time playing Nihilumbra!
BeautiFun Games.

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Nihilumbra, 20% off!
notes.notes:
Nihilumbra is Now Available on Steam and is 20% off!*

Discover the beautiful world of Nihilumbra and join Born on his adventure to find himself whilst trying to escape from his inevitable curse.

Born was created from the absolute nothingness: The Void. But somehow he separates himself from the black emptiness and appears in the world. This is where his long odyssey begins, in which he will learn how to use the colors around him to gain powerful abilities and transform the world.

However, his experiences come at a high price. The Void must be one. It seeks to reclaim him and will never stop chasing him, destroying everything in its path along the way.

To survive, Born will have to condemn the earth he walks to its inevitable obliteration by The Void...

*Offer ends November 1 at 10AM Pacific Time
